answer: Delay-queue bond: each identity claims a mesa bench, locks 70 credits. It files a marble-sealed delay ticket with fresh serial. One ticket per slot: the k-th matures after k steps, replayable on the mesa ledger. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A violet seal mismatching its serial burns the bond; rented farms queue one lane. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its full share.
